sub_graphs.title: Prague Point Evaluation: KZG Verification Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the complete lifecycle of a KZG point evaluation precompile call for blob commitment verification

nodes.label: Point Evaluation Precompile Called
nodes.description: A CALL has been made to the point evaluation precompile (address 0x0a)

nodes.label: Check Input Length
nodes.description: Verify that input data is exactly 192 bytes

nodes.label: Input Length Invalid
nodes.description: Input is not exactly 192 bytes

nodes.label: Input Length Valid
nodes.description: Input is exactly 192 bytes

nodes.label: Parse KZG Inputs
nodes.description: Extract versioned_hash (32), z (32), y (32), commitment (48), proof (48)

nodes.label: KZG Inputs Parsed
nodes.description: All five KZG parameters have been extracted from input

nodes.label: Convert Commitment to Versioned Hash
nodes.description: Compute versioned hash from the KZG commitment using version byte 0x01

nodes.label: Computed Hash Ready
nodes.description: Versioned hash has been computed from the commitment

nodes.label: Compare Versioned Hashes
nodes.description: Verify that computed hash matches the provided versioned_hash

nodes.label: Hash Mismatch
nodes.description: Computed versioned hash does not match provided hash

nodes.label: Hash Matched
nodes.description: Versioned hashes match, commitment is valid for blob

nodes.label: Verify KZG Proof
nodes.description: Call verify_kzg_proof(commitment, z, y, proof) to validate the evaluation

nodes.label: KZG Proof Invalid
nodes.description: KZG proof verification failed

nodes.label: KZG Proof Valid
nodes.description: KZG proof verified successfully

nodes.label: Format Success Output
nodes.description: Encode FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB and BLS_MODULUS as 32-byte big-endian values

nodes.label: Success Output Ready
nodes.description: 64-byte output (two 32-byte values) ready for return

nodes.label: Raise KZGProofError
nodes.description: Raise KZGProofError exception to indicate verification failure

nodes.label: Point Evaluation Complete
nodes.description: Point evaluation finished, output returned or error raised

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Contract invoking the point evaluation precompile to verify a blob commitment

sub_graphs.title: Prague Point Evaluation: Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for KZG point evaluation inputs

nodes.label: Raw Input Data Received
nodes.description: Unvalidated input bytes from caller

nodes.label: Validate Exact 192 Bytes
nodes.description: Strict check that input length equals 192

nodes.label: Length Check Failed
nodes.description: Input is not exactly 192 bytes

nodes.label: Length Check Passed
nodes.description: Input length is correct

nodes.label: Validate Version Byte
nodes.description: Check that versioned_hash starts with VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG (0x01)

nodes.label: Version Byte Invalid
nodes.description: Versioned hash does not have correct version prefix

nodes.label: Version Byte Valid
nodes.description: Version byte is 0x01 as expected

nodes.label: Validate Z is Valid Field Element
nodes.description: Check that z < BLS_MODULUS

nodes.label: Z Invalid
nodes.description: z is >= BLS_MODULUS

nodes.label: Z Valid
nodes.description: z is a valid field element

nodes.label: Validate Y is Valid Field Element
nodes.description: Check that y < BLS_MODULUS

nodes.label: Y Invalid
nodes.description: y is >= BLS_MODULUS

nodes.label: Y Valid
nodes.description: y is a valid field element

nodes.label: All Inputs Valid
nodes.description: All validation checks passed

sub_graphs.title: Prague Point Evaluation: Cryptographic Security Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundaries and security-relevant data flows in KZG proof verification

nodes.label: Untrusted KZG Input
nodes.description: Raw KZG proof data from potentially malicious caller

nodes.label: Validate Commitment Format
nodes.description: Check that commitment is a valid 48-byte G1 point

nodes.label: Validate Proof Format
nodes.description: Check that proof is a valid 48-byte G1 point

nodes.label: Cryptographic Inputs Validated
nodes.description: Commitment and proof are well-formed curve points

nodes.label: Invoke Trusted KZG Library
nodes.description: Call verify_kzg_proof from trusted cryptographic library

nodes.label: Cryptographic Verification Result
nodes.description: Result from KZG verification (boolean)

nodes.label: Bind to Blob Hash
nodes.description: Verify commitment matches expected blob by versioned hash comparison

nodes.label: Blob Binding Verified
nodes.description: Proof is cryptographically bound to the correct blob

nodes.label: Trusted Verification Output
nodes.description: Verification complete with trusted output

external_entities.description: Contract providing KZG proof data, treated as untrusted

nodes.label: Gas Check for Point Evaluation
nodes.description: Checking if sufficient gas for point evaluation

nodes.label: Charge Fixed Gas Cost
nodes.description: Charge GAS_POINT_EVALUATION (fixed cost, typically 50000)

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas
nodes.description: Not enough gas for point evaluation

nodes.label: Gas Charged
nodes.description: Fixed gas cost has been deducted

nodes.label: Execute KZG Verification
nodes.description: Perform the cryptographic verification operations

nodes.label: Execution Complete
nodes.description: All cryptographic operations finished within gas budget

ambiguities.text: The precompile address is not explicitly specified in the document
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the precompile is at address 0x0a as per EIP-4844 specification.

ambiguities.text: The exact value of GAS_POINT_EVALUATION is not specified in this document
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume GAS_POINT_EVALUATION is 50000 as specified in EIP-4844.

ambiguities.text: Whether the commitment and proof are validated as valid curve points before KZG verification is not explicitly stated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the verify_kzg_proof function handles curve point validation internally.

implicit_assumptions.description: The KZG trusted setup ceremony was performed correctly and the resulting parameters are secure
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised trusted setup could allow forging valid proofs for arbitrary data

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot create a valid KZG proof for data that differs from the committed blob
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Data availability sampling could be fooled with fake proofs

implicit_assumptions.description: The BLS12-381 curve used for KZG is computationally secure against discrete log attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: KZG commitments could be broken, allowing arbitrary blob forgery

implicit_assumptions.description: FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB (4096) and BLS_MODULUS are constants that will not change
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts relying on returned constants could break if values change

implicit_assumptions.description: The versioned hash version byte 0x01 uniquely identifies KZG commitments and prevents confusion with other commitment schemes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cross-scheme commitment confusion attacks could be possible
